t100-2024-women.publisherScope: Organizer explicitly identifies Knibb as 2024 T100 World Champion.

t100-2025-men.publisherScope: World Triathlon event is 2025; report explicitly confirms season-long title.

roth-triple.publisherScope: Organizer explicitly lists Ditlev wins 2022–2024; pre-race 2026 article, not evidence of current record after 2026 race.

roth-2024-record.publisherScope: Organizer report dated 7 July 2024 calls 7:23:24 a world best. Historical record only; not a ratified universal world record or a claim it remains current.

im-series-2024-women.publisherScope: Official IRONMAN Insider episode 38 description explicitly identifies Kat Matthews as 2024 Pro Series winner. No inference from race position.

pto-wilde-2026.publisherScope: Organizer identifies Hayden Wilde as PTO World #1 ahead of 25–26 April 2026; not a year-end ranking, not evidence of duration.
